leave.title: Leave {{name}}?
leave.description: You lose access to its tasks and projects and are unassigned from your tasks there. An admin can invite you again.

palette.description: Find pages, tasks and projects. Use the arrow keys to move and Enter to open.
palette.loadFailed: Tasks could not be loaded. Pages are still available.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.description: Shortcuts work anywhere in the workspace except while you type in a field. Pages you cannot open are skipped.
shortcuts.searchTasks: Search tasks, or open search from other pages
shortcuts.moveBar: Move a bar one day (Timeline, bar focused)

twoFactorGate.title: Turn on two-factor authentication
twoFactorGate.description: This workspace requires two-factor authentication. It takes about two minutes with an authenticator app, and you can come straight back.

workspaceError.title: We couldn't open this workspace
workspaceError.description: {{error}}. It may not exist, or you may not be a member.

forbidden.title: You do not have access to this page
forbidden.descriptionRole: Your role <r>{{role}}</r> does not include the permission this page needs. Ask a workspace owner or admin to update your role.
forbidden.description: Your role does not include the permission this page needs. Ask a workspace owner or admin to update your role.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Your latest notifications. Choose one to open its task.
notifications.loadFailed: We could not load your notifications.
notifications.emptyDescription: Assignments, mentions and comments on your tasks show up here.

pwa.offline: You're offline. Changes can't be saved until you reconnect.
pwa.updateDescription: Reload to get the latest TaskMan.

theme.saveFailed: We could not save your theme. It applies on this device only. Try again later.

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.description: Assignments, completed tasks, mentions and comments on your tasks. Notifications are kept for 90 days.
inbox.loadFailed: We could not load your notifications
inbox.loadFailedNext: Check your connection and try again.
inbox.emptyUnreadDescription: You have read everything. New notifications show up here.
inbox.emptyDescription: When someone assigns you a task or mentions you in a comment, it shows up here.
inbox.loadOlderFailed: We could not load older notifications. Try again.
